artists.biography:
Tori Amos (born Myra Ellen Amos; August 22, 1963) is an American pianist, singer-songwriter and composer. She is a classically trained musician and possesses a mezzo-soprano vocal range. Amos originally served as the lead singer of 1980s synthpop group Y Kant Tori Read, and as a solo artist was at the forefront of a number of female singer-songwriters in the early 1990s. She was also noteworthy early in her solo career as one of the few alternative rock performers to use a piano as her primary instrument. Some of her charting singles include "Crucify", "Silent All These Years", "God", "Cornflake Girl", "Caught a Lite Sneeze", "Professional Widow", "Spark", "1000 Oceans", and "A Sorta Fairytale", her most commercially successful single in the U.S. to date.
 
As of 2005, Amos had sold 12 million albums worldwide. She has been nominated for several awards, including 8 Grammy Award nominations. Amos was also named one of People Magazine's 50 Most Beautiful People in 1996.

perplexity.description:
Released in 1994, Under the Pink is the second studio album by American singer-songwriter Tori Amos. Recorded in a remote hacienda in Taos, New Mexico, the album showcases Amos’s distinctive blend of alternative rock and pop, marked by her virtuosic piano playing, unconventional chord structures, and emotionally charged lyrics. The music ranges from delicate, introspective ballads to bold, experimental tracks, often highlighting Amos’s dynamic vocal delivery and lyrical depth. The album’s sonic palette is both intimate and expansive, reflecting her willingness to explore complex themes and push the boundaries of mainstream pop.

Under the Pink solidified Tori Amos’s reputation as a leading voice in 1990s alternative music, following the success of her debut Little Earthquakes. It spawned several notable singles, including “Cornflake Girl,” “God,” “Pretty Good Year,” and “Past the Mission,” which received significant airplay and critical acclaim. The album debuted at number one on the UK Albums Chart and reached number 12 on the US Billboard 200, achieving multi-platinum status. Critics praised its lyrical sophistication and musical innovation, cementing its place as a landmark release in Amos’s discography and a defining work of 1990s pop-rock.
